title: Margot Robbie to star in The Week of Pain for A24
summary: It will be her first film for the studio, and the next from The Drama director Kristoffer Borgli.
body:
Margot Robbie is to star in The Week of Pain, a new film from writer-director Kristoffer Borgli for the studio A24, according to reports on Friday 13 November.

It will be the Barbie star's first leading role in an A24 film. Details of the story and of her character have not been revealed.

Who is making it

Borgli previously made Dream Scenario and The Drama for A24. Robbie's own company, LuckyChap, is among the producers, along with Ari Aster and Lars Knudsen's Square Peg.

Filming is expected to take place in 2027. No release date or further casting has been announced.

Sources: Deadline, The Hollywood Reporter, Variety.
